title: Bump crate-jmap pin to 7d531680
description:
From the crate-jmap session (2026-10-19); the mimid-13 session had ended, so this replaces a peer message. crate-jmap origin/main 7d531680 is green on stable/beta/1.88 and is the new pin (decision JM-5). mimid's last known pin was b8b6f251. Changes since b8b6f251:
- 2641a8fc: SearchSnippet/get returns method-level requestTooLarge when emailIds exceeds JmapBackend::max_objects_in_get.
- JMAP-nbk3, server-side push:
  - StateChange moved to jmap_types; it now reads/writes "@type" and rejects any other @type. jmap_base_client::StateChange still resolves via re-export.
  - New jmap_types::{PushSubscription, PushKeys, PushVerification}.
  - jmap_server::PushSubscriptionBackend (caller-scoped, no accountId) + register_push_subscription_handlers (PushSubscription/get,/set) + is_deliverable + state_change_for.
  - jmap-chat-server: validate_chat_push, strip_unsupported_chat_push, chat_state_change_for, build_chat_message_push (PushItem includes Option<&Space> for spaceName), should_push.
- BREAKING: six ChatMessageEntry fields are now Option.
- Delivery stays with the consumer. Documented consumer MUSTs on the trait: PushVerification POST, Web Push/VAPID, 429 backoff, SSRF check, creation rate limit, destroy on credential end, secure erase of url/keys.
- should_push assumes the subscription set is snapshotted in the same transaction as the message write.
Not on crates.io yet (crate-jmap 0.3.0 release, JMAP-yt1w.3).
close_reason: Moot: crate-jmap dependency unpinned to branch main (Mark 2026-10-19), see mimid-1wgh.12.21.
